name: Salem 1692

categories.label: Your side won
categories.hint: Townspeople or Witches win as a team

winCondition: Townspeople win when the final witch tryal card is revealed. Witches win when all townspeople are eliminated or the last remaining townsperson becomes a witch. No fixed round count and no tiebreak.

roles.label: Townspeople
roles.winCondition: Reveal the final witch tryal card

roles.label: Witches
roles.winCondition: Eliminate all townspeople or turn the last one into a witch

endCondition.description: Game continues through night and day phases until one side meets its condition

notes: family: hidden-role-social. No points. Verified only against a rulebook transcription, not the official PDF; 2-3 player variant and later editions not modelled.
